brainlife.desc: Spherical mean of the DWI signal at one b-value (NIfTI), averaging over gradient directions.
brainlife.name: neuro/spherical-mean

original.desc: Spherical mean image for a certain b-value

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Optional microstructure weight for structural connectome matrices.

**Not for:** Combining maps from different b-values without the b-value tag.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 3 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.spherical-mean.json

files.desc: Spherical mean image for a certain b-value

identifying_risks: NIfTI headers or metadata may carry subject codes or dates
Rare lesions or anomalies can be recognisable in small samples
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed diffusion MRI without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Check headers and metadata for identifiers before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only as a group-averaged template
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states

inputs_of.name: Structural Connectome MRTrix3 (SCMRT) - No labels or weights
inputs_of.purpose: structural connectomes without labels or weights (SCMRT)

intended_use: Optional microstructure weight for structural connectome matrices.
not_suitable_for: Combining maps from different b-values without the b-value tag.
